chapter: Style and old New Orleans customs
title: Lincoln Park, the skating rink and the gas balloon
summary: He recalls the old Lincoln Park skating rink and the Sunday gas balloon, which he thinks drew people to the park.

Never did see it. And a lot of people wouldn't have let me went nowhere,
because they were too strict on the outside at the time. Did you ever go to Lincoln Park at all later on?
Mm-mm. When I got big enough to go to Lincoln Park, it didn't want out. I used to stand in my yard and see them
when they sent that old gas balloon up on the outside. I never did find out much about that balloon. What did they do?

Well, now you see, I can tell you what they did. All I know, it went up every Sunday. We used to look at it after it got up in the air. I don't know. I don't know what the idea of setting it up. I don't know. I know positive. I don't think no people went up in it, because it was sent up by gas. And it would stay up for a little time and come down. To my idea, it was more of attraction of the park. You see? Draw people out to the park. That's what I think it was. That's the only thing I could picture it to be.
